description: This file defines the ModularPoFileLocationProvider class, which implements ILocalizationFileLocationProvider to locate localization (.po) files for modules and tenants in Orchard Core. It manages paths and retrieves relevant localization files based on culture and extension data.

classes.name: ModularPoFileLocationProvider
classes.description: Provides localization file paths for modules and tenants in Orchard Core based on culture and extension data.

methods.name: ModularPoFileLocationProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing path and extension management for localization files.

methods.name: GetLocations
methods.description: Retrieves a sequence of file info objects pointing to relevant .po localization files for a given culture.
